_about: Penalties the commissioner applies outside of games. Sleeper does not log them, so they live here. Rule: every member must post a league note once a year; if you don't, the commissioner takes FAAB. Each instance is one penalty (config tegridy.weights.missed_league_note). These were first spotted as FAAB that Sleeper counts as used but the transaction log doesn't explain; faab_taken is per instance. Only status 'confirmed' entries count toward Tegridy Factor. Optional 'description' text is shown with each penalty.

entries.description: Repeat offender: missed the league note multiple times in 2024 (Green and Bowled has a missed note in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024).

entries.note: One penalty for missing the note; the amount of FAAB taken was increased to $50 (not two separate penalties).
